fileNodes.name: 2026-04-20-file-upload-rag-ingestion.md
fileNodes.summary: Task-by-task implementation plan for the original file upload and RAG ingestion pipeline: a Celery-backed chunk/embed/store flow behind a document upload endpoint, an SSE status endpoint for progress polling, and the docker-compose service topology (frontend, backend, worker, redis, pgvector db) needed to run it, spanning 12 tasks from infrastructure setup through an end-to-end smoke test.

fileNodes.name: 2026-05-05-agentic-rag-chat.md
fileNodes.summary: Historical implementation plan (superseded 2026-06-28 when the stack moved off self-hosted Ollama to OpenRouter) for the original 'chat with document' feature: a ReAct-style agent that calls a pgvector search tool with a local qwen3 model and streams tokens/citations over SSE, covering the chat endpoint, DocumentSelector UI, and useChat hook across 11 tasks.

fileNodes.name: 2026-05-15-agentic-rag-enhancement.md
fileNodes.summary: Historical, phased implementation plan (superseded 2026-06-28) for rebuilding the RAG pipeline as a LangGraph CRAG-lite state machine — baseline RAGAS evaluation, parent-child chunking, RRF hybrid retrieval with FlashRank reranking, and a six-node agent graph (rewrite_query, retrieve_and_rerank, grade_chunks, rewrite_and_retry, generate_answer, faithfulness_check) — replacing the original regex-preprocessor and tool-loop agent in `rag.py`.

fileNodes.name: 2026-04-20-file-upload-rag-ingestion-design.md
fileNodes.summary: Approved v1 design spec for file upload and ingestion: a five-service pipeline (React, FastAPI, Redis, Celery worker, PostgreSQL+pgvector) that saves an uploaded PDF/DOCX/image, parses and chunks it, embeds chunks via OpenAI, and notifies the client over SSE when ingestion completes. Documents the original `documents`/`document_chunks` schema, the upload/status API contract, and the specific backend and frontend files the feature touches.

fileNodes.name: 2026-05-04-agentic-rag-design.md
fileNodes.summary: Approved-but-superseded design spec for the original 'chat with document' feature: a ReAct agent (qwen3 via Ollama) that iteratively calls a vector-search tool before streaming a grounded answer with citations, plus the DocumentSelector UI, useChat streaming hook, and SSE token/citations/done protocol. Carries a historical note that the stack later moved off Ollama to OpenRouter-hosted models.

fileNodes.name: 2026-05-15-agentic-rag-enhancement-design.md
fileNodes.summary: Design spec for the agentic RAG enhancement that replaces the single `rag.py` with the `backend/app/services/rag/` LangGraph package: parent-child chunking, hybrid (vector + FTS) retrieval fused via RRF and reranked with a cross-encoder, and a six-node CRAG-lite state machine (rewrite_query, retrieve_and_rerank, grade_chunks, rewrite_and_retry, generate_answer, faithfulness_check), plus a RAGAS-based evaluation harness and a four-phase rollout plan. This is the architecture CLAUDE.md currently describes as production, with a historical note that the model substrate later moved from Ollama/TEI to OpenRouter.

fileNodes.summary: Initial feature request for document upload and background ingestion: an upload button in the chat UI, storing document metadata in Postgres, and a background job that chunks, embeds, and stores vectors in pgvector before notifying the user.

fileNodes.name: nginx.conf
fileNodes.summary: Nginx reverse proxy configuration that serves the built frontend as an SPA, proxies /api/ requests to the FastAPI backend with buffering disabled for streaming responses, and sets long-lived caching headers for static assets.

fileNodes.name: app.py
fileNodes.summary: Standalone FastAPI OCR microservice exposing a health check and an /ocr endpoint that runs RapidOCR (ONNXRuntime) over an uploaded image and returns line-level text, bounding boxes, and confidence scores.

fileNodes.name: requirements.txt
fileNodes.summary: Pinned Python dependencies for the OCR microservice: FastAPI, Uvicorn, python-multipart, RapidOCR (ONNXRuntime), Pillow, and NumPy.

fileNodes.name: App.css
fileNodes.summary: Legacy create-vite scaffold styles (counter button, hero/logo layout, ticking animation) that appear to predate the chat UI rewrite and are no longer referenced from App.jsx.

fileNodes.name: index.css
fileNodes.summary: Global stylesheet entry point that imports src/styles/global.css, pulled in by main.jsx to bootstrap the app's base styles.

fileNodes.name: global.css
fileNodes.summary: Base global stylesheet applying a CSS reset, body typography/background driven by design tokens, and default button/input/link resets; imports tokens.css.

fileNodes.name: tokens.css
fileNodes.summary: CSS custom-property design tokens (Apple-Blue brand colors, backgrounds, text colors, radii, shadows, typography, and layout widths) shared across the app's stylesheets.

fileNodes.name: vite.config.js
fileNodes.summary: Vite build configuration registering the React plugin and proxying /api requests to the local FastAPI backend during development.
